model.adaptation: Original sewn mesh and baked knit/AO maps retained. Separate front/back print UV0, original material UV1, classified seam swatches and per-vertex AO. 19,517 triangles.

renderer: Self-hosted Three.js PBR renderer; same mesh with perspective-correct rasterization when WebGL is unavailable. No remote rendering service.
scarf: Original two-sided draped mesh with woven edge and individually modelled fringes.
cover: Rendered from the same garment with original SSL artwork.
reference: Studio Innate apparel photography and hanger presentation; no Studio Innate source assets are distributed.
